unit: Q2-token-links (c): the course follows the relink (research/reports/token_link_cascade_plan.md section 4, scenario D as a repoint)
what_this_is: Lessons that unlock a same-reading sibling of the word they actually teach. The unlock went through the same written-form lookup as the tokens (and W21b placed each one at the first lesson whose token links named it), so after the relink the sibling has no sentences and the word the lesson shows is unknown. Each row retires the sibling's unlock and its SRS card in `lesson` and unlocks the record the lesson teaches in the SAME slot, so every cumulative known set that held the sibling now holds the word; where the word was already unlocked later (`moved_from`), that later unlock and its card move here (introduce-once). Applied by scripts/apply_sibling_unlock_repoint.py to research/derived/lessons/<slug>.json and db/corpus.sqlite (lesson_unlocks, lesson_introduces, card_production_key, cumulative_known_set), and to the lesson-addressed tracked tables card_production_keys.json and w21b_forward_refs.json. Where the sibling was placed in `lesson` by W21b's first-use rule and the lesson W21b took it from teaches it in prose (`returns_to`), the sibling's unlock and card go back there: the move rested on the mislinked tokens, the prose did not.
card_keys: A moved card keeps its W27 key verbatim (re-homed, `verified: sampled`). A card with no W27 key (様, 呉れる) gets one derived by the W27 residue template: the record's pt-BR gloss for the sense the lesson teaches plus a cue naming the lesson's use, `accept` = the record's forms minus the JMdict-tag strip (scripts/build_card_key_table.py :: strip_accept), stamped `verified: derived` and listed for the teacher in research/reports/q2_token_links_report.md.

refused.why_refused: the lesson teaches 池 itself: its body lists <vocab ref="vocab:1421700"/> 'lago, lagoa' among the outdoor words for これ/それ/あれ and uses it again in prose ('indicar o 池 e o 海 a distância'). 池 is N5 in all four lists (pond). The 51 unlinks and 6 relinks to 行けない are いけません tokens, which were never what this lesson meant.

the lesson teaches 暮れる itself: its body lists <vocab ref="vocab:1514960"/> 'anoitecer' with 残る/増える/立てる as verbs to conjugate. The only くれる-as-give in the lesson is one W20 drill built on a mislinked token (regenerated by this unit). 呉れる is unlocked instead where the course teaches it (row 6).

rows.evidence: the audit relinks 932 する tokens 刷る -> 為る; no text of the lesson uses 刷る (body, readings), only the W20 drills built from the unlock; the lists' N5 する is 'to do' (level_transfer_repairs.json row 0). 為る was unlocked at les:n4-oracoes-relativas-07 by W21b's first-use rule; its card and key move here.

the audit relinks 397 なる tokens 生る -> 成る; no text of the lesson means 'bear fruit' (body and readings), only the W20 drills built from the unlock; the lists' N5 なる is 'to become' (level_transfer_repairs.json row 1). 成る was unlocked at les:n3-limites-06; its card and key move here.

rows.evidence: the audit relinks 51 かかる tokens 罹る -> 掛かる (3 disease rows keep 罹る) and every reading box that used 罹る means time or money (12 of 12), so every known set that held 罹る must hold 掛かる too. But this lesson's prose teaches 罹る itself ('Você vai ouvir também os verbos 罹る (contrair uma doença), 翔る (planar, voar) e 曇る'), so 罹る is KEPT and 掛かる is added beside it: an addition, not a repoint.
